name: hrow5_cbw-r5g-194034df4
purpose: el1011-ds-mtp 2026-10-12 hrow5_cbw r5g: r5f (halo 5.4) still DRC 7/12, all M4 Short/Spacing at the EAST edge pins (x 443.4) of the EAST-column SRAMs only. Asymmetry: the macro's x=174.72 pin set (w_mask_in 256 tied + wd_in 120 + redundancy) routes clean when it faces the 62.9 um central channel (west column) and fails when it faces the 31.75 um outer channel (east column); the x=0 set (rd_out/addr/wd_in 136) is clean facing the outer west channel. Fix (floorplan, structural): east column mirrored MY so the floorplan is mirror-symmetric -- both columns' tie-heavy mask/wd pin sets face the central channel, both rd_out/addr sets face an outer channel. Pin counts per channel unchanged (828 central, ~415 per outer). RTL/benches unchanged; halo 5.4 kept.
